name: vito-agent-plugins
description: Vito's personal Claude Code skill collection — research, planning, session reflection, content retrieval (YouTube/Bilibili/Xiaohongshu), media understanding (Gemini), and harness workflows. Bundles 14 skills auto-discovered from skills/, plus 9 companion subagents (agents/) that run the noisy skills in isolated contexts, and PreToolUse hooks that redirect inline skill usage to the corresponding subagent.
